actual_tool_job.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Return one corrected whole portrait card. Image1 exact rejected raw full-resolution target. Image2 unchanged original controls PRIMARY pose/roll/head placement/crop/light/clothes/hair. Image3 literal mascot identity/compact rounded anatomy only. Correct ONLY long pointed lower yellow head at blue-bow collar. Remove entire low V-like point, shorten mouth-to-chin distance substantially into a very SHALLOW SHORT BROAD ROUNDED U arc CLOSE under grey mouth, one COMPACT NEAR-ROUND head rather than egg-shaped human jaw. Lift/broaden original pale pointed shirt collar immediately beneath broad rounded base, minimal very short broad transition/coherent fabric overlap/contact shadow. No separate yellow shaft, V throat, pinched/floating or clipping collar. Preserve source strong IMAGE-LEFT near-profile three-quarter turn/roll/exact smaller head placement/crop/light, do not rotate frontal. Retain UNCOVERED short BROWN/GREY receding combed-back side-parted hair/grey temples/real brown-grey brow HAIR and only tiny subtle original upper-lip extent/CLEAN chin, no thick moustache/beard. Literal LARGE GREEN-RINGED BLACK CREATURE EYES/simple small GREY CLOSED mouth/smooth yellow anatomy without human nose/lips/wrinkles. OPEN BLACK/NAVY suit/PALE GREY-WHITE pointed shirt/BLUE SHORT BOW with LATERAL WINGS; pale area below bow is shirt front, not long tie. No cap/glasses/new pins/medals or invented tie pattern. Keep OPAQUE BEIGE/KHAKI-GREY backing/full tilted dark rim/cream note overlap, solid surfaces opaque, genuine alpha only outside whole-card silhouette; tiny details understated, no readable invented text or cream bib.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
